extraction.Name: Lillie Dixon, nee Twiss
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, when she received it, under date of September 29, 1919, to the SW¼, Sec. 9, T. 40N., R. 43W, of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota, as she did not want to pay taxes; but that she was forced to take it
extraction.Recorded patent: the deed was never recorded in the County
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1920, her husband, Gordon James Dixon, mortgaged her place to a Mr. Barker, of Brennan, South Dakota, for an old Ford car, which Mr. Barker priced at $250.00
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Mr. Barker, of Brennan, South Dakota, for an old Ford car priced at $250.00; Mr. Barker never foreclosed on this mortgage, which was due three or four years ago
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she has never paid any taxes on her land; the mortgage was for an old Ford car, not taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband works at common labor to support her and the family
extraction.NOTES: Deponent states she considers she still owns the land; land is described as very good land and she can get a renter for it; has pretty poor health, has doctored for the last two years, having been in the hospital; mother of three children who have pretty good health; has never received any assistance from the United States Government, nor the State or County governments; this car has never been paid for; document signed June 3, 1930 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
